Let me start by understanding the current state of the project. ls -la /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/ find /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation -type f -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" -o -name ".env*" 2>/dev/null | head -30 cat /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/package.json 2>/dev/null || echo "No package.json found" cat /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || echo "No tsconfig.json found" ls -la /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No src directory" cat /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/README.md 2>/dev/null || echo "No README.md found" ls -la /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/.github/workflows/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No workflows directory" Now let me check if there are any existing implementation files or documentation: find /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation -name "*.md" -type f 2>/dev/null cat /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/.claude/inputs/*.md 2>/dev/null || echo "No detailed plan found" ls -la /home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/.claude/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No .claude directory" ## Analysis Summary Based on my exploration, this appears to be a **greenfield project** - the repository structure exists but no implementation has started yet. The project needs to be built from scratch following the architecture defined in CLAUDE.md. ## Implementation Plan ### **Phase 1: Project Foundation (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Goal**: Set up TypeScript project with strict configuration and pnpm workspace **Steps**: 1. Initialize `package.json` with pnpm - Add dependencies: `googleapis`, `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (or axios for OpenRouter), `winston`, `dotenv` - Add dev dependencies: `typescript`, `@types/node`, `jest`, `ts-jest`, `@types/jest`, `tsx` (for dev running) - Configure scripts: `build`, `start`, `test`, `test:watch` 2. Configure `tsconfig.json` with strict mode ```json { "compilerOptions": { "strict": true, "noImplicitAny": true, "strictNullChecks": true, "target": "ES2022", "module": "NodeNext", "moduleResolution": "NodeNext", "outDir": "./dist", "rootDir": "./src" } } ``` 3. Create `.env.example` with required keys: ``` GMAIL_CLIENT_ID= GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET= GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN= OPENROUTER_API_KEY= USER_EMAIL= ``` 4. Create `.gitignore` (exclude `node_modules`, `dist`, `.env`, `logs/`) **Dependencies**: - None (first phase) --- ### **Phase 2: Type System & Configuration (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Goal**: Define all interfaces and domain configurations as the contract for the system **Steps**: 1. Create `src/types.ts` with core interfaces: ```typescript interface InputEmail { id: string; threadId: string; domain: string; // e.g., "java" rawContent: string; receivedDate: Date; } interface EmailMetadata { from: string; subject: string; snippet: string; cleanedBody: string; // Sanitized for AI } interface AISummary { title: string; // Max 50 chars impact: string; keyPoints: [string, string, string]; // Exactly 3 action: string; } interface OutputEmail { to: string; subject: string; htmlBody: string; domain: string; } interface DomainConfig { label: string; color: string; // Hex code inputLabel: string; // "Input/Java" outputLabel: string; // "Output/Java" } ``` 2. Create `src/config.ts` with hardcoded domain configs: ```typescript export const domains: Record = { java: { label: "Java", color: "#FF6B6B", ... }, angular: { label: "Angular", color: "#DD0031", ... }, // ... all 8 domains }; ``` **Dependencies**: - Phase 1 complete **Validation**: - All interfaces compile without `any` types - Domain config exports correctly --- ### **Phase 3: Gmail API Layer (Estimated: 3-4 hours)** **Goal**: Implement OAuth2 authentication and CRUD operations for Gmail **Steps**: **3.1 Authentication (`src/gmail/auth.ts`)** - Implement OAuth2 client initialization from env vars - Validate scopes: `gmail.readonly` + `gmail.modify` - Export `getGmailClient()` function **3.2 Fetch Emails (`src/gmail/fetch.ts`)** - Function: `fetchUnprocessedEmails(domain: string): Promise` - Query: `label:"Input/{domain}" -label:Processed` - Use `users.messages.list` + `users.messages.get` (format: `full`) - Map to `InputEmail` type **3.3 Extract Metadata (`src/gmail/extract.ts`)** - Function: `extractMetadata(inputEmail: InputEmail): EmailMetadata` - Parse headers: `From`, `Subject` - Extract HTML body (prefer over plain text) - **Content sanitization**: - Remove `\r\n` → spaces - Strip `\"` - Truncate to 2000 chars - Strip PII (email addresses, names if detectible) **3.4 Send Email (`src/gmail/send.ts`)** - Function: `sendProcessedEmail(outputEmail: OutputEmail): Promise` - Create raw RFC822 message with base64 encoding - Send via `users.messages.send` - Apply labels: `Output/{domain}` **3.5 Mark Processed (`src/gmail/labels.ts`)** - Function: `markAsProcessed(messageId: string): Promise` - Add `Processed` label via `users.messages.modify` **Dependencies**: - Phase 2 (types) **Critical Considerations**: - Use exponential backoff for rate limits (Gmail has quotas) - Never log full email content (only metadata) - Validate Gmail API responses (check for undefined fields) --- ### **Phase 4: AI Layer (Estimated: 3 hours)** **Goal**: Generate structured summaries via OpenRouter with strict validation **Steps**: **4.1 Prompt Engineering (`src/ai/prompt.ts`)** - Function: `buildPrompt(metadata: EmailMetadata): string` - Template: ``` You are an ADHD-friendly newsletter summarizer. Analyze this technical email and return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown wrappers). Required structure: { "title": "50 chars max", "impact": "Why this matters", "keyPoints": ["Point 1", "Point 2", "Point 3"], "action": "What to do next" } Email content: {metadata.cleanedBody} ``` **4.2 OpenRouter Client (`src/ai/openrouter.ts`)** - Function: `generateSummary(prompt: string): Promise` - HTTP POST to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` - Model: `meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-free` - Headers: `Authorization: Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` - Retry logic: 429 → exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s), max 3 attempts - Log: tokens used, duration, status (NOT full response) **4.3 Response Parser (`src/ai/parser.ts`)** - Function: `parseAISummary(rawJson: string): AISummary` - Steps: 1. `JSON.parse()` with try-catch 2. Validate schema: - `title.length <= 50` - `keyPoints.length === 3` - All strings non-empty 3. Throw error on invalid (log raw JSON, skip email) **Dependencies**: - Phase 2 (types) **Security**: - Never trust AI output (strict validation) - Sanitize content before sending to AI (done in Phase 3.3) - No PII in prompts --- ### **Phase 5: HTML Renderer (Estimated: 2 hours)** **Goal**: Generate ADHD-friendly HTML with domain-specific styling **Steps**: **5.1 Template (`src/renderer.ts`)** - Function: `renderSummary(summary: AISummary, domain: DomainConfig): string` - Structure: ```html

{title}

💡 Impact

{impact}

📌 Key Points

  • {keyPoints[0]}
  • {keyPoints[1]}
  • {keyPoints[2]}

🎯 Action

{action}
``` **5.2 Inline CSS** - All styles inline (no external CSS) - Use domain color for header/border - Yellow action box with red border-left **Dependencies**: - Phase 2 (types, config) **Testing**: - Verify HTML structure (h1, h2, ul) - Check emoji presence (💡, 📌, 🎯) - Validate color injection --- ### **Phase 6: Logging System (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Goal**: Centralized logging with Winston (console + file) **Steps**: **6.1 Logger Config (`src/logger.ts`)** - Winston transports: - Console: `level: "info"`, colorized - File: `logs/app.log`, `level: "debug"` - Error file: `logs/error.log`, `level: "error"` - Format: `timestamp + level + message + metadata` **6.2 Log Levels** - `info`: Batch start/end, email processed count - `debug`: API calls, AI requests - `error`: Failures (with stack traces) - `warn`: Skipped emails, retries **Dependencies**: - Phase 1 (winston dependency) **Security**: - Never log API keys, tokens, or full email content - Redact sensitive fields in metadata --- ### **Phase 7: Main Orchestration (Estimated: 2 hours)** **Goal**: Batch processor that ties all modules together **Steps**: **7.1 Main Loop (`src/main.ts`)** ```typescript async function processDomain(domainKey: string) { const config = domains[domainKey]; const emails = await fetchUnprocessedEmails(config.inputLabel); for (const email of emails) { try { const metadata = extractMetadata(email); const prompt = buildPrompt(metadata); const rawJson = await generateSummary(prompt); const summary = parseAISummary(rawJson); const html = renderSummary(summary, config); await sendProcessedEmail({ to: USER_EMAIL, subject: `[${config.label}] ${summary.title}`, htmlBody: html, domain: config.label }); await markAsProcessed(email.id); logger.info(`Processed ${email.id} for ${config.label}`); } catch (error) { logger.error(`Failed to process ${email.id}`, { error }); // Continue with next email } } } async function main() { logger.info("Starting newsletter batch processing"); for (const domainKey of Object.keys(domains)) { await processDomain(domainKey); } logger.info("Batch processing complete"); } ``` **7.2 Error Handling** - Individual email failure: Log + continue - Gmail auth failure: `process.exit(1)` - OpenRouter 429: Retry with backoff - AI parsing failure: Log raw JSON + skip **Dependencies**: - All previous phases --- ### **Phase 8: GitHub Actions (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Goal**: Weekly automated execution **Steps**: **8.1 Workflow (`.github/workflows/run-batch.yml`)** ```yaml name: Newsletter Automation on: schedule: - cron: "0 8 * * 1" # Mondays 08:00 UTC workflow_dispatch: # Manual trigger jobs: process: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 20 cache: 'pnpm' - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - run: pnpm run build - run: pnpm start env: GMAIL_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID }} GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET }} GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN }} OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }} USER_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.USER_EMAIL }} - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: failure() with: name: logs path: logs/ ``` **8.2 Secrets Setup** - Add all 5 secrets in GitHub repo settings - Document in README.md **Dependencies**: - Phase 7 (main.ts working) --- ### **Phase 9: Testing (Estimated: 3 hours)** **Goal**: 80% coverage for business logic **Steps**: **9.1 Parser Tests (`tests/parser.test.ts`)** - Valid JSON parsing - Invalid JSON rejection (malformed, missing fields) - Schema validation (title length, keyPoints count) - Edge cases (empty strings, null) **9.2 Renderer Tests (`tests/renderer.test.ts`)** - HTML structure verification - Domain color injection - Emoji presence - Action box styling **9.3 Mock Strategy** - `EmailMetadata` + `AISummary` fixtures - No real Gmail API calls (mock with jest.fn()) - No real OpenRouter calls (mock with sample JSON responses) **Dependencies**: - Phase 5 (renderer) and Phase 4 (parser) --- ### **Phase 10: Security Review (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Checklist**: - [ ] `.env` in `.gitignore` - [ ] No API keys in code - [ ] No logging of tokens/full emails - [ ] AI responses validated (schema enforcement) - [ ] Content sanitization before AI (PII removal) - [ ] Gmail OAuth scopes minimal (readonly + modify only) --- ### **Phase 11: Documentation (Estimated: 1 hour)** **Files to create**: **11.1 README.md** - Project overview - Setup instructions (pnpm install) - Environment variables - Running locally (`pnpm start`) - GitHub Actions setup **11.2 .env.example** - Template with all required keys - Instructions for obtaining OAuth tokens --- ## Trade-offs & Design Decisions **1. No Aggregation (1-to-1 Processing)** - **Pro**: Simpler logic, easier debugging, preserves email context - **Con**: More API calls, higher quota usage - **Decision**: Follow CLAUDE.md constraint (no aggregation) **2. OpenRouter vs Direct Anthropic** - **Pro**: Free tier, multiple models, no vendor lock-in - **Con**: Extra network hop, less direct support - **Decision**: Use OpenRouter (as specified in CLAUDE.md) **3. Inline HTML Styling** - **Pro**: No external dependencies, works in all email clients - **Con**: Harder to maintain, repetitive - **Decision**: Inline CSS (email compatibility critical) **4. Sequential Processing (not parallel)** - **Pro**: Easier rate limit management, predictable quota usage - **Con**: Slower batch processing - **Decision**: Sequential (Gmail API quotas are low) **5. Winston for Logging** - **Pro**: Production-ready, flexible transports, structured logs - **Con**: Overkill for small project - **Decision**: Winston (GitHub Actions artifact upload needs file logs) --- ## Potential Challenges **1. Gmail API Quotas** - **Issue**: 250 quota units/user/second, 1B/day - **Mitigation**: Exponential backoff, batch size limits, retry logic **2. OpenRouter Rate Limits (429)** - **Issue**: Free tier has aggressive limits - **Mitigation**: Exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s), max 3 retries **3. AI JSON Parsing Failures** - **Issue**: Llama may return markdown wrappers (`json\n{...}\n`) - **Mitigation**: Prompt engineering ("ONLY JSON, no markdown"), regex stripping **4. HTML Rendering Across Email Clients** - **Issue**: Outlook/Gmail render HTML differently - **Mitigation**: Inline styles, avoid complex CSS, test in multiple clients **5. OAuth Token Refresh** - **Issue**: Refresh token may expire (requires manual reauth) - **Mitigation**: Document reauth process, add error handling with clear message --- ## Implementation Sequence **Week 1 (Phases 1-4)**: 1. Foundation + Types (2 hours) 2. Gmail API (4 hours) 3. AI Layer (3 hours) **Week 2 (Phases 5-8)**: 4. Renderer + Logger (3 hours) 5. Main orchestration (2 hours) 6. GitHub Actions (1 hour) **Week 3 (Phases 9-11)**: 7. Testing (3 hours) 8. Security + Docs (2 hours) 9. End-to-end testing (2 hours) **Total estimated effort**: 22 hours --- ### Critical Files for Implementation - `/home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/types.ts` - Core interfaces (InputEmail, EmailMetadata, AISummary, OutputEmail, DomainConfig) - foundation for all modules - `/home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/config.ts` - Domain configurations with colors and labels - referenced by renderer and main orchestration - `/home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/ai/parser.ts` - AI response validation logic - highest complexity and security risk (untrusted input) - `/home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/renderer.ts` - HTML generation with ADHD-friendly structure - directly impacts user experience - `/home/kevdev/Developpement/Workspaces/TypeScript/newsletter-automation/src/main.ts` - Batch orchestration tying all modules - core business logic and error handling strategy
